# Rohan Chaudri

Professional profile for Rohan Chaudri, a machine learning engineer, product builder, and data scientist.

Canonical site: https://rohanchaudri.com/
Contact: rohanchaudri@berkeley.edu
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohanchaudri/
GitHub: https://github.com/rchaudri

## High-Signal Summary

- Rohan Chaudri is a machine learning engineer with work in conversation analysis, finance and wildfire risk agents, and myoelectric hardware.
- His experience spans private model integrations, GPT-5.1 and Gemini 3 Pro integrations, natural language processing, predictive modeling, customer interviews, product requirements, and data/API workflows.
- He has more than two years of hands-on experience across artificial intelligence, analytics, and product work.
- He is fluent in Mandarin Chinese and brings an international economics perspective.

## Education

- University of California, Berkeley: Bachelor of Arts in Data Science, 2020-2024.
- Georgia Institute of Technology: Master of Science in Computational Data Science, 2024-2026, in progress.
- Coursework includes applied natural language processing, analytics modeling, database systems, data structures, probability and inference, data engineering, and data ethics.

## Recognition

- United States Senate Certificate of Commendation for Distinguished Achievement, signed by United States Senator Dianne Feinstein on July 12, 2019.
- The Senate commendation recognized participation in the Congressional Academy for American History and Civics and dedication to American civics.
- Winner, Alameda County Science and Engineering Fair for a myoelectric bionic hand.
- Perfect SAT Math score: 800.
- Perfect SAT Biology score: 800.
- Google Cloud Data Analytics Certificate, issued in 2025 and valid through 2028.

## Projects

- Real-Time Meeting Coach: private machine-learning pipeline that analyzes more than ten conversation signals and uses current frontier models, including GPT-5.1 and Gemini 3 Pro, for adaptive feedback.
- CFO Agent: finance assistant that parses financial statements, generates insights, compares benchmarks, supports forecasting, and preserves private-deployment requirements.
- Wildfire Risk Agent: geospatial risk forecasting system trained on the United States Wildfires Database for utility risk analysis.
- Artificial Intelligence Game Engine: minimax search with alpha-beta pruning, improving decisions from minutes to seconds.
- Enigma Machine Simulator: historically accurate rotor, reflector, and plugboard simulation for encryption and decryption.
- Myoelectric Bionic Hand: six-year independent engineering project using muscle-signal sensors, signal processing, intent classification, 3D-printed parts, motors, and tendon-like strings.

## Skills

- Programming and data: Python, Java, SQL, web APIs, Pandas.
- Systems and frameworks: FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit.
- Machine learning: GPT-5.1 integration, Gemini 3 Pro integration, random forest models, nearest-neighbor models, generalized linear models, natural language processing, prompt engineering.
- Product: user interviews, product requirements, market requirements, roadmaps, self-service analytics, stakeholder communication.
